mapper.select:
SELECT c.cno, c.title, c.content, c.uno, u.name, TO_CHAR(c.created_at, 'yyyy.mm.dd') AS dbday, (SELECT thumbnail FROM place WHERE pno = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.pnos, 1, INSTR(c.pnos, ',') - 1)) ) AS thumbnail FROM course c JOIN users u ON c.uno = u.uno WHERE is_public = 'Y'
AND (title LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR content LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
